title: Hotstart orchestrator: parameter staging and cache probing for cold-start shrink
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement a Hotstart Orchestrator for Dedicated fleets that reduces cold-start latency and token-cost spikes by proactively staging model parameters and performing lightweight cache probes. This ticket covers the orchestrator control loop, tenant-priority residency scoring, staged parameter transfer policy, safe soft-eviction behavior, and a small probing mechanism to hydrate the key-value cache without impacting SLOs. The orchestrator should integrate with the existing fleet admission controller and metrics pipeline, and provide knobs for per-tenant SLAs and budgeted warmup credits.
acceptance_criteria: Average model startup latency (cold -> ready) reduced by >= 60% for medium-sized models in Dedicated pools compared to baseline
95th percentile cold-start latency under loaded conditions < 500ms for majority of tenant tiers (configurable)
Hotstart controller exposes per-tenant residency score and warmup actions in Console (logs + events)
Safe soft-eviction prevents thrashing: if parameters are evicted within 30s of load, controller backoff increases and admission controller rejects non-critical warm requests
Operator can set weighted tenant priorities and warmup budgets; changes respected within one control loop iteration
